scope: submit the 21st catalog entry, and correct two assumptions I had been carrying

corrections.wrong: a new package needs to be a day old before its catalog entry can be submitted
corrections.actual: MIN_AGE_DAYS = 1 applies to the repository's created_at, not to the npm publish date; there is no commit floor either (dropped 2026-09-03 in #4196). The repository is 9 days old, so the entry was submitable the same day the package was published.
corrections.cost: would have delayed this submission by a day for no reason

corrections.wrong: my repositories satisfy the submission checklist
corrections.actual: all three repositories had an empty topics array. The PR template explicitly asks for the dsh-plugin topic, and 26 entries had already been merged without it — the gate does not check topics, so nothing ever complained.
corrections.fix: added dsh, dsh-plugin, deepseek-harness to all three repositories
corrections.whyItMatters: topics are how GitHub search and topic pages find a plugin repository; the gate passing said nothing about discoverability

prBody.says: npm-published at 0.1.0; kit is now 259 tests across 21 packages, audit 21/21 clean, 148/148 rules covered in both directions
prBody.describesTheRule: an error on a missing accounts section, satisfiable by writing 无账号需交接 — the exemption has to be written down, silence is what it refuses
